primitives.name: Regulatory Posture Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: What GSE *is* (regulatory posture) GSE is a **paid sports-analytics/content subscription** — it does **not** accept wagers, hold customer funds, or settle bets.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{\\text{wager}}': '\\text{Probability of wager acceptance} \\in [0,1]', 'P_{\\text{fund}}': '\\text{Probability of fund holding} \\in [0,1]', 'P_{\\text{settle}}': '\\text{Probability of bet settlement} \\in [0,1]'}
primitives.assumptions: GSE operates in a non-regulated subset of gambling activity; P_wager = 0, P_fund = 0, P_settle = 0.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P_wager > 0, regulatory boundary is crossed.

layer2.mapping: GSE's operational kernel is defined by zero probability of core wagering functions, enabling a lighter regulatory footprint.
layer2.telemetry: Compliance audit score, derived from absence of wagering-related events.

primitives.name: Promotion Gate Enforcement
primitives.verbatim_quote: Already enforced in code (`verified-code`) GSE's data model + service layer encode an above-average compliance posture: - **Promotion hard-gates** (`schema.prisma` Promotion; `apps/web/lib/promotions/*`): public render requires non-empty `disclosureText`, `termsUrl`, `responsibleGamingText`, `status=ACTIVE` + `complianceStatus=APPROVED`, not expired.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'G_{\\text{promo}}': '\\text{Promotion gate state} \\in \\{0,1\\}', 'T_{\\text{disclose}}': '\\text{Disclosure text present} \\in \\{0,1\\}', 'T_{\\text{terms}}': '\\text{Terms URL present} \\in \\{0,1\\}', 'T_{\\text{RG}}': '\\text{Responsible gaming text present} \\in \\{0,1\\}', 'S_{\\text{status}}': '\\text{Status active} \\in \\{0,1\\}', 'S_{\\text{compliance}}': '\\text{Compliance approved} \\in \\{0,1\\}'}
primitives.assumptions: All required fields must be truthy for G_promo = 1.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If any field is falsy, G_promo = 0.

layer2.mapping: Promotion gate state mirrors the logical conjunction of all compliance metadata fields in GSE’s promotion system.
layer2.telemetry: Promotion rendering success rate, measured against metadata completeness.

primitives.name: Age and Geolocation Access Control
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Geo + age gating**: `eligibleStates` (allow-list) + `restrictedStates` (deny-list); `minimumAge` default **21**; honest "not available in your state" rather than fabricated availability.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A_{\\text{min}}': '\\text{Minimum age threshold} = 21 \\, \\text{years}', 'S_{\\text{eligible}}': '\\text{Eligible state set} \\subseteq \\mathcal{S}', 'S_{\\text{restricted}}': '\\text{Restricted state set} \\subseteq \\mathcal{S}', 'G_{\\text{access}}': '\\text{Access granted} \\in \\{0,1\\}'}
primitives.assumptions: Access is granted only if user age ≥ A_min and state ∈ S_eligible \setminus S_restricted.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If age < A_min or state ∈ S_restricted, G_access = 0.

layer2.mapping: Access control is a derived kernel from age and geolocation constraints, enforcing a conditional access function.
layer2.telemetry: User access denial rate per jurisdiction and age group.
